aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.content:
## LangGraph Fundamentals

- TypedDict defines state shape.
- State is passed to nodes.
- Nodes update state.
aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.summary: LangGraph uses TypedDict for state, passed through nodes.

bbbbbbbb-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.content:
## State Management

- Nodes never mutate state directly.
- All fields are optional in total=False.
bbbbbbbb-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.summary: Nodes return new state dicts; fields are optional.

cccccccc-0000-0000-0000-000000000003.content:
## Graph Execution

- START connects to the first node.
- Edges define execution order.
- Conditional edges route on state values.
- END terminates the graph.
- Checkpointer persists state between runs.
cccccccc-0000-0000-0000-000000000003.summary: Graph execution flows from START to END via edges and conditional routing.
